SELECT count(1) FROM kx_store_order WHERE uid = #{userId}
AND `status` = #{status}
SELECT order_id FROM kx_store_order WHERE `status` = #{status} AND update_time < #{time}

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS waitingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 16 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS beingDistributed, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS waitingToBeDelivered, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inDelivery, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 40 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedCount FROM kx_store_order WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH);
and store_id = #{storageId}
